untouched: strings without non-ASCII characters (numbers, file names, ids)

strings.en:
In the era known as S.C., the wars against aliens and
visitors from a parallel world had ended, and some
time had passed...

Aidoneus Island, off the Marquesas in the South Pacific:
once the impact site of Meteor 3, the meteorite sent by
the alien Aerogators, and the base of the Divine Crusaders
(DC), the military society that sparked a civil war...

The surrounding waters were sealed off, and the
island long vanished from history's stage. But behind
the scenes, a plan was steadily advancing.

It was the founding of a special ops unit acting at the sole
will of the Earth Federation President, using ISA tactics
(blitzkrieg by mobile battleships acting as carriers and the
humanoid weapons aboard them)... codename: GS.

GS is a force independent of the Federation Army,
tasked with the President's special military orders.

Under the command of two Special Presidential Aides,
Aidoneus Island was being refortified, and the fruits of
many projects, along with numerous new weapons, were
being gathered there. But GS's true nature was kept
secret; officially, it was a test unit for new weapons.

Will GS become a new sword to defend the Earth Sphere?

Countless powers and schemes shake space-time...
and open the gate to another world...

An amnesiac boy who escaped the sealed Aidoneus Island, seeking the
answer to who he is, with only the words "Steel Dragons" as a clue. But just
short of escape, he runs into an enemy force...

An unknown enemy force appears before Ibis and Raul during a long-range
cruise test of the Alterion, the latest Series 77 unit, developed under the
late Filio Presty in the interstellar Project TD. After driving off the enemy,
Raul's group finds a drifting escape pod and contacts the Earth Federation
Army's Steel Dragons to take in the unidentified boy aboard.

Masaki Andoh, pilot of the Wind Masoukishin Cybuster, returns to La Gias, an
underground world in another phase space within the Earth. In the Holy
Kingdom of Langran, leaderless after a terror attack and reeling from the
Schtedonias Union's invasion, he meets Excellen, a Steel Dragons pilot, and
Neue DC remnants, and learns many Surface Dwellers were summoned here.

Masaki's group sorties to halt the Schtedonias invasion, joined by Diablo,
piloted by Mio Sasuga, a girl summoned from the surface. Mid-battle, the
Steel Dragons' Space Noah-class battleship Hagane appears, pursued by
Luozorl, an Archbishop of the Volkruss cult, and Masaki joins the Steel
Dragons to search for comrades summoned to La Gias.

To uncover the truth of the summonings and go home, the Hagane group
visits Ibn, a priestess of Langran. But REB, the quantum computer the
return spell needs, has been hacked and possessed by a false personality.
After beating the enemy, the group heads to the capital at Ibn's urging.

Meanwhile, Lüne Zoldark, who was in Space investigating Neue DC remnants,
is also summoned to La Gias and meets Huang Yang Long, pilot of the Fire
Masoukishin Granveil. Under General Kirkus Zan Valhalevia, the Langran
officer spearheading its liberation, Yang Long is fighting the invading
Schtedonias army as a free-roaming force.

Lüne's group faces the Schtedonias army to rescue their comrades. The
Masoukishin were born from the Masouki Project, a humanoid weapon plan to
counter the Majin foretold by the Langran Royal Academy's Foresight, but
Schtedonias saw them as a threat, one cause of its invasion.

Suspicious of General Kirkus, Yang Long learns from an old acquaintance,
Saphine the Crimson of the Volkruss cult, that Prince Feilord Gran Bilseia,
Langran's missing first heir, is alive. Lüne's group reunites with the Steel
Dragons' multipurpose battleship Hiryu Custom, and Captain Lefina meets
Kirkus and pledges to help him in order to return to the surface.

The Hagane sets course for Coral Canyon to join Tutti Norbac, pilot of the
Water Masoukishin Gaddess. But waiting there is the Steel Dragons' SRX
Team, forced to fight the Hagane group by the Schtedonias army, which
holds hostages...

After joining Tutti and the others, the Hagane group sets out to rescue
Princess Monica Grania Bilseia, Langran's second heir, held in the occupied
capital. A lone unknown unit approaches...

At Prince Feil's request, the Hagane group attacks the Schtedonias army
south of Banan City. The trump card of the cornered General Rodney Jessha
is the Earth Masoukishin Zamzeed.

When Yang Long questions Kirkus's slights to Prince Feil, Kirkus suggests
Feil may be involved in the summonings. With the Harmony Barrier collapsed
by terrorism and fears of the revival of Volkruss, the God of Destruction,
the Hiryu Custom group investigates the Temple of Volkruss and rescues
Leona, about to be sacrificed to Volkruss by the demon priest Luozorl.

After retaking Zamzeed from Schtedonias, Masaki's group learns Zamzeed
has chosen Mio as its pilot. Joining Prince Feil, the Hagane group stages a
diversion against the Schtedonias forces to support Feil's army in retaking
the capital. Princess Xenia, rescued from Schtedonias, tells them her sister
Monica was taken away by Shu.

Meanwhile, the Hiryu Custom group is escorting Prince Tellius Gran Bilseia,
Langran's third heir, under Kirkus's protection. Yang Long worries that
Kirkus is scheming to crown Tellius, which would spark new strife in Langran.

Kirkus tells the Hiryu Custom group that Surface Dwellers are held at a
Schtedonias base. Yang Long and Lüne infiltrate it and, with the aid of
ex-Instructor Sänger Sombold, who shows up as well, free their hostage
comrades. Heading to Kirkus, the group meets Shu Shirakawa and fears he
plans to revive Volkruss.

Having retaken Langran's capital, Prince Feil proposes an alliance with General
Kirkus against Schtedonias, and Kirkus names his condition: the coronation of
Prince Tellius, third in line.

Yang Long parts ways with Kirkus, who means to sideline Prince Feil, the
rightful heir, and seize real power by crowning Tellius. In Kirkus, who dreams of
uniting La Gias by force, Lüne sees her late father, Bian Zoldark.

Together, Feil's and Kirkus's armies drive Schtedonias out of Langran. But
Prince Tellius's coronation is held without Feil present, and Feil becomes
convinced the Tellius at the ceremony was an impostor. The Hagane picks up
a suspicious Masouki, likely from Kirkus's army, and rushes to the scene.

The false coronation splits Feil and Kirkus. Kirkus's army marches to seize
the capital, but the Hagane group arrives and stops it. The battle is decided,
and the defeated Kirkus vanishes.

On request, the Hagane group heads to Mt. Grimold, where the Schtedonias
army is hiding. Inside the caves, Masaki's group learns from Luozorl, a demon
priest aiding Schtedonias, that it is the temple of Sarva Volkruss, the God
of Destruction...

After defeating Volkruss's Afterimage, the Hagane group returns to the
capital, but the Afterimage regenerates from a fragment of Volkruss stuck
to Cybuster. Prince Feil sorties in the newly designed super Masouki Duraxyll
and annihilates it with overwhelming power.

As peace returns to Langran, Feil suddenly takes the throne as its 288th
king, founds a new legitimate government, declares war on the Schtedonias
Union, and leads his own forces toward Nagor Bay in Baldia Province. Masaki
vows to stop him, fulfilling his duty as a Masoukishin pilot.

Meanwhile, the cornered Kirkus's trump cards for uniting La Gias are
mass-produced Valsion Custom Type CFs summoned from the surface and
the secret super Masouki Eulid, said to surpass even the Masoukishin.
Beaten by the Hiryu Custom group, Kirkus atones with his life.

Obsessed with pacifying La Gias by force, Feil rejects Masaki's pleas, and
battle becomes unavoidable. Feil reveals that the strain of winning the right of
succession and wounds from the terror attack have left him little time, and
that the summonings were caused by a spell he cast to save the kingdom from
ruin, which ran out of control...

The Steel Dragons' Hiryu Custom and Hagane, reunited in La Gias, return to
the surface, leaving behind Masaki's group of Masouki pilots and Lüne.

Two weeks before the Steel Dragons return from La Gias, the Yokijin seen in
the Shura Revolt attack the Tesla Reich Institute again. Kukuru, with them,
says she has come for the Choukijin RyuOhKi and KoOhKi sleeping in the cage...

Robert says Grungust parts could save RyuOhKi. Dr. Anzai suspects the unit
that took KoOhKi was a Choukijin; her LTR Organization's secret files
describe Baral, a shadowy group that used Choukijin and Yokijin. Facing this
new threat, Federation President Grayen Grassman is convinced he needs
the Gaia Savers, a unit under his direct command.

Hugo Medio and Aqua Centrum, pilots of Cerberus, the sixth TE Absorber
prototype from the Tsentr Project, are attacked by a mysterious force during
a test flight to their new post. After they join the Instructors, the fifth TE
Absorber prototype, Medius Locus, appears and attacks. Mitar, receiving the
report, says it was stolen by someone.

Joshua Radcliff is the test pilot of the Aile Chevalier, built by the
Re-Technologists (Re-Tech) who excavate and study the Antarctic ruins
Fabula Foresse, and is on loan to the Instructors at Izu Base. During a mock
battle between the newly rolled-out seventh TE Absorber prototype,
Garmraid, and the Aile Chevalier, Yokijin launch a surprise attack.

The Instructors visit Mao Industries' Orleans plant to transport the entire
Huckebein series to Hickam Base. They repel an unidentified Armored Module
(AM) force, but its behavior leaves them uneasy...

The Armored Modules that attacked the plant were piloted by bioroids much
like those used by the Inspectors, aliens who recently tried to invade Earth.
On the way back to Izu, the Instructors move to meet the Kurogane to hand
over the Exbein, secretly built for adjusting AM parts...

A message from the mysterious Jinrai reveals its targets are Dynamic
General Guardians (DGG), and it aims to destroy DGG Units 1 and 2. On the
way back, while fighting an enemy AM force, the Kurogane group is
ambushed by teleporting mobile weapons and pushed to the brink...

The ones who save the Kurogane group are the missing Steel Dragons. Guest
Commander Zeb hints at raids on key Federation bases...

Rätsel suspects Earth's response to the surprise attacks was due to a leak.
The Steel Dragons, just back from La Gias, are ordered by Far East
Command to return to Izu Base.

Learning the secret of Project Idealands, the truth of the death of its head
Dr. Ozunu, and the truth of the Pfau Kern powering the Ares Geist, Arieil
Org decides to desert the Gaia Savers. Meanwhile, Yokijin attack the Tesla
Institute, targeting the RyuOhKi under repair...

After repelling the Yokijin, Raul's group detects an approaching unit: the
Flickerei Geist and its pilot, Arieil. In pursuit comes the Ares Geist, piloted
by Duban Org, Beta Saber captain of the Gaia Savers, who demands they
hand over Arieil and Ing, who happened to be there...

The mysterious unit codenamed Evil leaves, as if its goal had been to
awaken Ing. Arieil reveals she is an artificial human, an Idealand, created by
Project Idealands, and that she fled to warn of the danger of the Pfau Kern,
the power source at Jetzt Regisseur's core...

Josh's group returns to the Antarctic Mother Base. But an anomaly occurs
at the Fabula Foresse ruins, and an unknown enemy appears when they go to
the rescue. As they try to enter with Josh's stepsister Cliana Rimskaya in
the Blanche Neige, a new unknown appears and calls itself Ruina, the bringer
of fear, despair, and ruin.

Josh's father, Prof. Ferio Radcliff, believed Fabula Foresse was a gate to
another world; the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige were insurance against
the calamity coming from it. Escaping Antarctica, the group joins the Steel
Dragons, but when Ruina's Meliores Esse Aquila appears, Josh and Rim are
confused by enemy voices only they can hear.

The Gaia Savers block the Steel Dragons as they rush to the ruins. Special
Presidential Aide Arteur Steinbeck, accusing them of ties to anti-Federation
forces, demands they disarm. Rejecting this absurd ruling, Colonel Lefina,
commander of the Steel Dragons, tries to break the encirclement...

After the President dies in an accident, the Steel Dragons are hunted by
both the Gaia Savers and the Federation Army. The crew suspect Arteur
aims to assassinate the President and frame them as traitors...

The Hiryu Custom group is thrown into confusion by a sudden anomaly. Ignis,
one of the Meliores Esse, says Ruina has shut Earth in darkness. Then
appears Kota Azuma, missing since being sucked into a dimensional door.

A dimensional fault around the planet has cut Earth off from Space. The ES
wave from Antarctica passed between the two ships: the Hiryu Custom was
trapped on Earth, the Hagane flung into Space. To learn the truth, the
Hagane group heads for Heaven's Gate, where Ruina went.

At Rätsel's suggestion, the Hiryu Custom calls at Commodin Island, but Jinrai
appears targeting the DGGs, and Ibis rescues Irui, a girl terrified by the attack.
Re-Tech and the Tsentr Project are under Gaia Savers control, and a
transmitter planted in the TE Absorbers has been giving away the Hiryu
Custom's location.

After leaving Commodin Island, the Hiryu Custom group meets a new
Meliores Esse, Glacies. Through Sympathia, an unknown man-machine
interface in his unit, Josh experiences a psychic link with Glacies and hears
her inner voice. Using his words as a clue to the dimensional fault's cause,
the group heads for the Arctic Ocean.

Former Federation Lieutenant Colonel Lee Linjun, missing since the
Inspector Incident, closes in on the Steel Dragons as Carly Naumann, captain
of Air Christmas, the Gaia Savers flagship. And Alpha Saber captain Egretta
Uno reveals he is Egret Uruz, originator of the Machinery Children defeated
at Earth Cradle.

Meanwhile, the Hagane group, bound for Heaven's Gate, meets the Guest
army, which sees Earth's plight as a chance to seize the Moon and Heaven's
Gate. They drive off Commander Grofis Laclaine, but then run into the Beta
Saber, in Space to support the Antarctic operation from orbit. Then appears
their old acquaintance, Alchemie...

Alchemie leaves Axel Almer, former Shadow Mirror captain who came back
from the other world with her, on the Hagane, and departs. As the Hagane
changes course for the Moon, Guest Commander Justine Shafrawarth
suddenly appears. The Vaisaga, piloted by Axel, saves the Hagane.

The Hagane group joins Radha, who fled the Guest at Mao Industries, the
lunar Personal Trooper maker, and learns Moon Cradle has fallen. In Omega
Saber Armara Burton, who relentlessly hunts Ing in Galilnagant, the unit
codenamed Evil, the group senses Arteur's schemes.

The Hagane heads to Heaven's Gate to capture Ignis, who knows the truth of
the barrier, but finds Ruina fighting the Guest, who want the station. The
Hagane group pursues Ignis as she withdraws.

On Earth, the Hiryu Custom group enters the Arctic Ocean seeking clues to
the barrier. Bullet keeps trying to reach the black KoOhKi that appears, but
his voice doesn't get through. At the north magnetic pole, they meet the
Gaia Savers attacking the barrier Septemplum; among them Hugo finds the
supposedly stolen Medius Locus and senses Mitar's scheme.

Rim links minds with the Meliores Esse Ventus. Clifford suspects Sympathia
is the key to breaching Septemplum, and Rim tries to approach it, but the
Meliores Esse Umbra moves to block her way...

Chasing Ignis, the Hagane group arrives not at Antarctica, home of Fabula
Foresse, but above the North Pole. As they fight a fierce battle with
Contagio and the other Meliores Esse, a sudden anomaly occurs...

Rim and Ventus's psychic link dispels Atrum Exterior, the dimensional fault
covering Earth, and the Hiryu Custom, joined by the returned Hagane, heads
for Itiiti Island, home to a secret underground base under Rätsel's care.

To show off Delta Saber's Jinrai, Dr. Tomine proposes a Violent Assault on
the BF Base of Dr. Kisaburo Azuma, Kota's grandfather. Meanwhile, Kota,
home on a visit as the Steel Dragons pass near Japan, faces Michiru
Hanaten, gang boss of Mannamu Academy, who came from Kansai to fight
him. Then an enemy appears, and Kota's group sorties to protect Asakusa...

Compatible Kaiser combines with Shoko's G-Thundergate, and G Compatible
Kaiser lures the Mass-Production Jinrai out of town. Minaki, daughter of Dr.
Tomine, visited Dr. Azuma for hints on better linking Jinrai's AI, System
ZLAI, with the DGG's ABMD (artificial skeletal muscle drive) system, and
decides to go with the Steel Dragons to stop her father.

En route to Itiiti Island, the Steel Dragons are pulled into the closed space of
Gensenkyo. Baral has led the Choukijin since ancient times, guarding Earth
from the Hundred Evils. Its sages Kanan Jun and Taihoku Santayu ask them
to pioneer the Total Shikai Plan, by which Baral's god grants all mankind
shikai (shedding the flesh to become sages). Refused, they resort to force...

Trapped in Gensenkyo at a stalemate, the Steel Dragons are saved by a
shark-shaped unit that appears as if in step with a change in Irui.

Medius Locus appears before Hugo and Josh on patrol. Hugo is shaken to learn
its pilot is Albero Est, captain of his old unit, the Federation's 3rd Special Ops
PT Unit Crywolves. Arado's group, arriving as backup, sees fellow Boosted
Children from the School, Cienne Argent and the others.

The ATX Team, out to wipe out Ruina, is cornered by TotetsuOh and KyukiOh,
Choukijin of the Four Fiends. Bullet falls to KoOhKi, and as Kusuha grieves, a
voice calls out to her...

Reclaiming RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh, Kusuha and Bullet repel Baral with Axel,
Rishu, and others who come to help. As Ruina's raids on bases throw the war
into chaos, Jinrai, after the DGGs, and Medius Locus, after the TE Absorbers,
appear before the Steel Dragons.

At Minaki's wish to give Jinrai a new life, Sänger's group captures it.
Meanwhile, pursuing Medius Locus alone, Hugo's pair releases the TE Limiter
and corners Albero. To escape, Erde Mitte, creator of AI1, the AI aboard
Medius Locus, reveals who she is to Aqua, her former student at the military
academy...

Medius Locus withdraws, leaving Aqua behind. Grieving at losing Hugo through
her mistake, Aqua learns Hugo's body was mechanized and he had little time
left. On patrol for the Steel Dragons heading to Itiiti Island, Ibis meets Sleigh
Presty, who has left Isurugi Heavy Industries for the Steel Dragons, and Ibis
tries to accept all that Sleigh is...

Sleigh defeats the mercenary Araceli and joins the Steel Dragons. The
information she brings from Mitsuko Isurugi, president of Isurugi Heavy
Industries, about Shu Shirakawa's actions is startling.

At Shu Shirakawa's invitation, Guest supreme commander Teiniquet
Zezenan, Gaia Savers commander Arteur Steinbeck, and the Masoukishin
pilots led by Masaki all gather in one place...

Masaki's group destroys the remaining Guest forces, and Zezenan
withdraws. Shu's ploy exposes the Gaia Savers conspiracy, and Federation
Lieutenant General Jacob Moore announces the Steel Dragons' arrest order
is withdrawn. What the departing Shu entrusts to Masaki is Tronium, the
Tronium Engine's power source, missing since the DC War.

Testing the Tronium Engine built into the Ash, Ing's group picks up a
distress signal and goes to help. Waiting there, Alpha Saber's Egretta
reveals that Ing is a Machinery Child created by Egret Fehu. To escape the
crisis, Ing starts the untested Tronium Engine...

The Ash, of the ill-omened bird lineage, is reborn as the Exexbein. The Steel
Dragons arrive as reinforcements. Over her grief for Hugo, Aqua boards the
remaining TE Absorber. Lieutenant General Jacob orders the Steel Dragons to
attack Tochka 8, a Gaia Savers base where NV Units using Re-Tech
technology are being developed.

En route, Masaki, on patrol, finds Lüne's group, up from La Gias, fighting
Ruina. Reaching Tochka 8, the Steel Dragons attack, and Josh's group
searches for the NV Unit.

They repel Medius Locus and the Gamma Saber and take Tochka 8, but soon
Glacies and the other Meliores Esse appear to eliminate Josh and Rim...

Their Sync deepening, Josh and Rim come to know their hearts deeply. Josh
is torn by his own wish to save Glacies from her fate.

Meanwhile, Minaki and the others have remade Jinrai as RaiOh. When
Mass-Production Jinrai attack Itiiti Island while the Steel Dragons are away,
Touma sorties in RaiOh to save the base and succeeds in luring the enemy
away as a decoy, but...

Suddenly, RaiOh's System LIOH activates BSK Mode, and the berserk RaiOh
attacks the DGGs. It is a system planted by Dr. Tomine to fulfill its purpose
even if refitted as a manned unit. Judging their location exposed, the Steel
Dragons leave Itiiti Island, but Medius Locus and a new TE Absorber appear
before Aqua's group...

Hugo is rescued, but Albero is absorbed by AI1 in his place. Albero aided the
Tsentr Project because of Mitar's lies about saving his son, Foglia Est. Vowing
revenge, Hugo sorties in TE Absorber Unit 8, Cerberus Ignite, and Unit 9,
Garmraid Blaze, refitted by Dr. Eric Wan.

Following Rim, who heard Ventus's call through Sympathia, the Steel
Dragons reach a base seized by Ruina. Josh and Rim enter it, where Ventus
and Glacies wait. But Contagio's plan is to have Glacies and Ventus
self-destruct, taking the Steel Dragons with them...

Touching Sympathia gave Rim two personalities, Chris and Riana. But Chris
vanished to save Ventus and Riana. Having failed their roles and lost their
place, Glacies and Ventus pledge to help the Steel Dragons. Meanwhile,
Excellen senses Alchemie is in danger and goes to save her with Axel and the
others...

Learning the truth that Idealands live only about three years, Duban deserts
the Gaia Savers and absorbs Alchemie to escape his fate. The enemy is
repelled, but back aboard, Ibis's group learns Irui has disappeared.

As Operation Reconquista, to retake the Guest-held Moon, and Operation
Icebreaker, against Ruina in Antarctica, are readied, Son Koryu, self-styled
head of Baral, sends a message hinting at the Total Shikai Plan. Federation
Marshal Gaspar Gilan orders an H-MAP Weapon strike on the Garden of
Baral, risen over Arabia's Nafud Desert...

A barrier from the Garden of Baral covers Earth, cutting it off from Space.
The Hiryu Custom, already in Space to join Operation Icebreaker from above
Antarctica, is attacked by Custos, guardians from the Garden of Baral. Cut
off from the surface, the Hiryu Custom joins Operation Reconquista under
Colonel Humphrey Innes, commander of the allied space fleet.

Meanwhile, the Hagane, repairing its Tesla Drive, was left on the surface.
Arteur promises to end the pursuit, but the Gamma Saber breaks it, and
Marshal Gaspar sends the Hagane to Grand Christmas, the Gaia Savers HQ,
to settle the President's assassination.

The Delta Saber blocks the Hagane group's way to Grand Christmas. Minaki
breaks with her father, and before the might of Touma and RaiOh, Dr.
Tomine's obsession is crushed.

Convinced the Steel Dragons are being used for Arteur's aims, Captain
Tetsuya resolves to confront the Gaia Savers. Arado's group defeats the
Argent-class Boosted Children, and Sänger and Rishu put an end to Murata.

Meanwhile, the Hiryu Custom storms the Guest-held Heaven's Gate. There
appears Mekibos, thought killed in the Inspector Incident. He relays Zezenan's
recall order and says he was sent as an envoy of the Zovorg Privy Council to
end the war with Earth. The Inspectors and the Guest, as Earth calls them, are
Zovorg's two great factions, the Wolga and the Zogal.

At Grand Christmas, as the Hagane group battles Egretta's Gaia Savers,
Garberus, TE Absorber prototype Unit 10 carrying AI1, appears. After a fierce
fight, Erde falls, and Ing's Black Hole Buster Cannon ends the originator
Egretta.

Creator Fehu dies without revealing Ing's origins, and the Steel Dragons
face a fight for survival with the remaining Arteur. But the Air Christmas
scuttles itself under the Hagane's attack, to everyone's bafflement.

At the same time, Operation Reconquista begins on the Moon. Shu exposes the
plot to assassinate Rof, the Guest Commanders turn on Zezenan, and the Hiryu
Custom descends on Moon Cradle as the final battle with the Guest begins...

After a ferocious battle, Zezenan falls and the war with the Guest ends. The
Hiryu Custom carries out Shu's plan to return to Earth, sealed by Ruina's
barrier Meridemplum and Baral's barrier...

The Hiryu Custom and Hagane reunite and, aided by Glacies and Ventus,
enter Meridemplum, the barrier over Antarctica. Defeating Aquila, Contagio,
and the others waiting at Mother Base, the Steel Dragons storm the ruins...

The Steel Dragons reach the heart of Fabula Foresse, and Ryusei and the
others feel deja vu at the structure. It is a gate linking different
space-times and worlds: the Cross Gate. Ignis and Umbra, blocking the way,
offer their own deaths to awaken the King of Ruin...

Sympathia: a replica of the "key" that opens and closes the gate, made by
the ancients who sealed the Cross Gate, and a device that turns those who
touch it into Meliores Esse. Riana is shaken to learn Chris was the real
Cliana Rimskaya. Prof. Radcliff, his Sympathia working as a true "key" due
to another factor built into it, was made a vessel for Perfectio...

Fed endless energy by the Cross Gate, Perfectio overwhelms the Steel
Dragons though only an Afterimage. As its true body's emergence from the
Cross Gate draws near, the group is pushed to the brink...

Through the sacrifice of Ventus and Chris, the threat of Perfectio's true
body is averted. Then, seeking the energy from the Cross Gate, the Ares
Geist and Garberus, thought destroyed at Grand Christmas, appear...

True to its name, "ALL In 1," AI1 tries to absorb everything into itself. In his
desperate fight with AI1, Hugo hears a voice speaking to him...

After the Steel Dragons seal Perfectio, Baral's head Son Koryu summons
them to Gensenkyo again to carry out the Total Shikai Plan.

Son Koryu likens OryuOh's clash with the Steel Dragons to Baral's ancient
Great Mech War with the Hundred Evils. Seeing Kusuha's group's resolve,
Taihoku accepts fate and leaves with Kanan, and Koryu falls in a fierce fight.

Gan Eden: an artificial god that links with a powerful psychic called a Mashiach
to cover Earth in a mighty barrier, and aims to create a paradise free of
conflict by imposing the Total Shikai Plan on mankind. Irui says she stays with
Gan Eden of her own will, but...

Responding to Ibis's group's voices, Irui's two personalities clash. Rejected by
Irui, Gan Eden tries to cut her off and erase her. The Steel Dragons, with Irui,
face Gan Eden...

Euzeth Gozzo: of the Ze Balmary Empire's Inspection Army and mastermind of
the L5 Campaign. And the Adamatron, built to make false memories real and
break the chains of causality. It is the Cross Gate Paradigm System, which
controls Gan Eden via Ing, a man-made Mashiach, fuses with the Cross Gate
via AI1, and bends causality at will via the Akasha variable factor.

Seeking to erase the karma of past lives and build a new cycle of rebirth,
Euzeth tries to wipe out the Steel Dragons himself. Before the cornered Steel
Dragons appears Lee Linjun, set on atoning for his own sins...

Everyone's feelings reach Irui, absorbed along with Gan Eden, and through her
own will the Cross Gate Paradigm System is left incomplete. Freed from his
shackles, Ing drives Euzeth into a corner...

With Arteur revealed as the one behind the L5 Campaign and proof of the
President's assassination found at Grand Christmas, the Gaia Savers are
dissolved. The Zovorg Privy Council resolves not to interfere with Earth; the
Guest army leaves the Earth Sphere, with Mekibos staying as liaison. And
Masaki's Masouki pilots and Lüne return to La Gias.

To make RaiOh a true guardian, Touma and Minaki go with Axel and Alchemie
to stay with Rätsel, returning to Itiiti Island. And Ing accepts Irm's offer to
join a newly formed team.

Cleared of the charges, the Steel Dragons return to Izu Base, and Dr. Wan sees
in the technology of Lamia's body a chance to extend the Idealands' lives.
Meanwhile, knowing Glacies's inescapable fate, Josh vows to stay always by
her side...
